description.zh:
数仓版集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

description.zh:
资源组名称。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBResourceGroup](~~459446~~)接口查看指定集群的资源组名称。
description.en:
The name of the resource group.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBResourceGroup](~~459446~~) operation to query the resource group name of a cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-resubmit-config --resource-group-id rg-4690g37929XXXX --db-cluster-id am-8vbyw9awuj141haf9 --group-name test_group --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
